//: Hand-edited companion to block_entities.json. Carries the small residue that ToolingBlockEntities cannot yet derive: forced inventory_y_rotation for the few models where the RendererTransformDecomposer cannot cleanly separate GUI-facing yaw from the render-side PoseStack (chest, skulls, banners), and generator-time inventory_transform for entities whose distinguishing translate comes from the model geometry rather than the renderer bytecode (currently just skull_dragon_head, whose tz=1.25 originates in DragonHeadModel.createHeadLayer). The inventory_transform field is consumed only by ToolingBlockEntities at generation time - BlockEntityLoader reads inventory_transform directly from block_entities.json at runtime. Split into per_entity (keyed by entity model id, applied to every block variant) and per_block (keyed by blockId, applied to a specific variant only); BlockEntityLoader merges both onto the auto-generated block_entities.json entries at load time. Pattern-derived per-block fields (iconRotation on beds, additive on bells, tint on banners) are now emitted by the tooling directly into block_entities.json - no per_block entries remain here.
